scope: 96 paired synthetic crops, three procedural families. Observed QA, not held-out generalization. Nine fixed-mask fits, no automatic crop replay or physical assembly test.

method.method: Sort designs within each family by SHA-256(seed/id); take the first N. Select one view per design with the same rank. No detector outcomes or image labels enter selection.

classification.method: Per-image unsupervised; no ground-truth label input. Deterministic strided sample <=16384 RGB pixels. 25 EM iterations, full covariances with fixed diagonal ridge. Production auto initializes component identities.
classification.scoring: Per-image global phase aligned to known pre-blur material label; only overlap-valid pixels with value 255, target >127.5. Pure-material subset label <=12 or >=243. Equal weight per image. This is inspected synthetic QA, not held-out generalization.

componentCollapseDiagnosis.scope: Post-hoc diagnosis on two observed collapses. Synthetic homography and known paper footprint are evaluation-only; no label enters classification. Footprint is continuous planar geometry at crop pixel centers, not a prediction or post-blur material label.

fits.scope: Fixed prepared masks. No automatic crop. Ground-truth labels are scored after fitting and never enter initialization.

conclusion: Reject unconditional covariance classification; mask fit error cannot select photographic correctness. Keep production default. Investigate spatial illumination or boundary proposals against fixed material labels.

archive.verification: Every archived member re-read and SHA-256 verified; archive integrity, not an execution replay of every experiment.
archive.sourceSubset: Original dataset manifest plus all selected design/view assets, not the unselected source assets.
archive.replayRequirements: Use producer commit 289b2b3 in a repository checkout with its dependencies. Experimental scripts retain repository-relative paths; restore the experiment root or edit paths to a fresh directory, and use the source-dataset copy when replaying generation.
